updatePolicy: Compare each patched source and generated browser/minified entry against the recorded upstream tarball; rerun root regression and full build before updating. Restore registry packages only when all listed issues have an upstream fix.

securitySourceDiff.scope: Runtime source diff against the SHA512-verified official npm tarball. sprintf dist outputs retain the already rebuilt Leng fork; source and minified entrypoints are both tested.
securitySourceDiff.format: Zero-context unified diff; apply to the exact recorded upstream tree with git apply --unidiff-zero.

validationInThisRepository: pnpm test:security:vendor; pnpm audit; full build/unit/SFC/SSR/types/browser regression
